exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
outcome: demographic variables (age, occupation, level of education)
cohort: The study included all women who were admitted for delivery in Sanandaj's hospital in Iran during a one-year period.
finding: The caesarean section delivery rate in Sanandaj was 42.18% in 2012-2013, and a significant association was found between delivery mode and maternal outcomes, as well as with demographic variables like age, occupation, and level of education.
mod_finding: There was a statistically significant association between delivery mode and maternal outcomes, with a caesarean section rate of 42.18% in Sanandaj during the study period.
